markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary:
If Cushman & Wakefield reports that Manhattan’s overall office vacancy rate for Q4 2026 is below 

18.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the Manhattan overall vacancy rate reported in Cushman & Wakefield’s Q4 2026 Manhattan Office MarketBeat, covering the overall Manhattan office market. Subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.

For reference, the same metric was 21.1% in Q4 2025, 19.9% in Q1 2026, and 19.3% in Q2 2026.
markets.title: Will Manhattan’s overall office vacancy rate for Q4 2026 be below 18.0%?
